caption:
Most missed trips from Dubai are not refusals. They are timing.

Appointment availability at UAE consulates tightens sharply before peak season. Once the slots are gone, no amount of preparation gets them back.

Work backwards from your travel date: appointment wait, processing time, and a buffer for anything that needs correcting. Then start before that.
